 f.text(.035,.94,title,fontsize=23,weight='bold')

def bar(ax,labels,values,chosen,xmax,xlabel):

 ax.tick_params(axis='y',length=0,pad=12);ax.grid(axis='x',alpha=.22,zorder=0)
 for i,v in enumerate(values):ax.text(v+xmax*.018,i,f'{v:.2f}',va='center',fontsize=12,weight='bold' if i==chosen else 'normal')
def save(f,name):
 f.savefig(OUT/name,dpi=170);plt.close(f)

for key,color,label in [('wins',TEAL,'Winning plan'),('proofs',GRAY,'Impossible proof'),('unknowns',AMBER,'UNKNOWN')]:

ax.legend(loc='upper left',bbox_to_anchor=(-.35,-.20),ncol=3,frameon=False,fontsize=10,handlelength=1.2,columnspacing=1.2)
